notes: A performer singing on stage to a crowd the players join is Entertainment, and the genre is explicit that this is venue-stage rather than a stage treated as a landmark: orientation is the design, so sightlines converge and the floor is sized for crowd density. Performance Venue fits with all three options kept — the 1980s stadium answer makes raked seating necessary to keep the stage visible from the back, which is the whole of the tiered route — and I added npc-population, since a named figure players come to see is exactly what the option covers and the crowd around them belongs to the same pick. Decided without a user: players dance on the floor rather than on stage, so no performer-side space and no backstage-support, keeping the build off P3, and the stage front stays sealed to the audience. Nothing here needs a modifier beyond the seating, so it stays on the proven pipeline.
